content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the Solr slave performing a full replication of the entire index after the master node was restarted, even when the index had not changed. This behavior was due to the slave not properly tracking the success of the last replication in a ZooKeeper-aware environment, leading to unnecessary full index fetches instead of incremental updates. The patch introduced a check to ensure that replication success is only tracked in SolrCloud mode, preventing the slave from re-fetching the entire index when it was not necessary.
